[EN] Mission Orders

Eliminate the Cursed Legion troops in the Scorched Snowfield.

Report to Errill when the mission is complete.
[ES] Orden de misión

Elimina a las tropas de la Cursed Legion en Scorched Snowfield.

Preséntate ante Errill cuando la misión esté completa.

[EN] Here's your reward, as well as the Valkyon Federation's gratitude!
[ES] ¡Aquí tienes tu recompensa, así como la gratitud de la Valkyon Federation!

[EN] It looks like you haven't completed your mission yet.
[ES] Parece que aún no has completado tu misión.
